message.projecthero.spin.valkyrie_dismis: Valkyrie gallops off. You can call her again in 10 seconds
projecthero.spin.ability.steel_ball.desc: Throw the ball in your main hand up to 30 blocks (with your main hand empty, the ball in your off hand goes instead, and comes back to that hand). On its way out it curves after your aim: look where you want it to go, and flick your crosshair onto a creature to bend it in (the turn can't be too sharp). It hits for 10 damage and spins its body for 3 seconds: it staggers about and can't aim. The ball always flies back into your hand. With an empty main hand, R first calls back a ball you dropped or left in a chest. 15 Spin.
projecthero.spin.ability.golden_spin.des: Hold to charge. A gold rectangle shrinks onto your crosshair; let go as it lines up with the frame for a Perfect Spin: the ball tears through blocks and creatures in a 40-block line for 70 damage that ignores armour. 50 Spin, 12 s cooldown. Miss the timing and it is an ordinary Steel Ball throw instead (10 damage, 15 Spin, no Golden Spin cooldown). Twice as quick to line up on a horse.
projecthero.spin.ability.ball_breaker.de: Hold to charge like the Golden Spin. Only a Perfect Spin works: Ball Breaker, a lime armoured figure studded with magenta gems and crowned with two great discs, bursts out of the ball and strikes the creature you aim at (30 blocks) for 100 damage through armour, then ages it for 10 seconds: Weakness II, Slowness III and a withering that bites for 1.7 every 2 seconds (8.3 in all). A release that isn't Perfect fails and costs 20 Spin. 100 Spin, 3 min cooldown.
projecthero.spin.ability.valkyrie.desc: Tap to whistle for your horse Valkyrie. If she isn't out, she gallops in and you mount. If she is, she runs to you from wherever she is and you mount when she reaches you (stuck or far away, she is brought to you after a moment). There is only ever one Valkyrie. Hold for 1 second while she's out to send her away: she gallops off and is gone, and you can't call her for 10 seconds. She's tamed, saddled, armoured, very fast and has 40 health. If she dies you must wait 60 seconds before a whistle brings her back.
projecthero.guide.spin.balls.body: Learning the Spin gives you two Steel Balls, and the moves need you to hold them. Keep a ball in your main hand for Steel Ball, Spin Touch, Golden Spin, Ball Breaker, Scan, Spin Quake, Healing Spin and Face Spin, and one in each hand for Twin Balls and Spin Shield; Spin Leap and Valkyrie need none. Steel Ball also throws the ball in your off hand when your main hand has none. Without them a move does nothing and is greyed out on the HUD. A thrown ball leaves your hand and flies back into the same hand (or a free slot if you've filled it). The balls are yours alone: you keep them when you die, nobody else can pick them up, and with an empty main hand R calls back a ball you dropped or left in a chest. A ball destroyed in lava or the void comes back by itself after 30 seconds.
projecthero.guide.spin.golden.body: Holding Golden Spin or Ball Breaker shrinks a gold rectangle onto your crosshair. Let go while it lines up with the frame (it flashes white) for a Perfect Spin: double damage that ignores armour. If you miss the timing, Golden Spin is just an ordinary Steel Ball throw, and Ball Breaker doesn't come out at all.
projecthero.guide.spin.valkyrie.body: Tap Shift+X to whistle for Valkyrie, your own horse. She comes galloping and you mount. If she's already out, she runs to you and you mount when she arrives (if she gets stuck or is too far away, she is brought to you). You only ever have one Valkyrie. Hold Shift+X for 1 second while she's out to send her away: she gallops off and disappears, and you can't call her again for 10 seconds. If she dies, she can come back after 60 seconds.
